info.title: SmartCRM API
info.description: Single-company CRM. PKR, en-PK, Asia/Karachi. Strict validation, JWT access authentication, rotating HttpOnly refresh cookies, record assignment permissions, and transactional mutations.

get.description: Authenticated users. Staff CRM records are restricted to their own assignments; record IDs outside scope return 404.

401.description: Missing, expired, revoked, or invalid authentication

403.description: Insufficient role, assignment, or trusted-origin permission

404.description: Record is missing or outside permitted scope

409.description: Duplicate record, linked-record deletion, or last-Admin conflict

422.description: Invalid fields, date range, ID, or reference

500.description: Internal error; no implementation details are exposed
